THE SPLIT PLATE / RECIPE

Carnitas Taco Plate

Del Real tray seared frozen, fat drained, broth-braised under a glass lid = real carnitas texture in 8 active minutes. The kid compartment tray IS the brand thesis — parent picks what's available, kid picks the assembly order.

YIELD4 servings
TOTAL TIME15 min
COOK METHODSee method
EST. / SERVING~565 cal | ~30g protein
KEY TO SUCCESS: TWO PHASES: SEAR (fat drain) → BRAISE (broth + lid). The Del Real tray is fully cooked but needs both phases to read as real carnitas instead of heat-and-eat. Sear renders + crisps edges; braise re-hydrates the shred. Skip either and the meat is wrong.

Ingredients

PROTEIN

  • 1 tray (15 oz) Del Real Slow-Cooked Carnitas

CARB

  • 10-14 Mission Yellow Corn Tortillas Super Soft (count: ~3.5 per adult + ~2.5 per kid + 2 extra in case of breakage)

ADULT TOPPINGS (adults only)

  • 2-4 tbsp Mezzetta Pickled Red Onions (1-2 tbsp per plate, in a small deli cup or ramekin)
  • Lucky Dog Hot Sauce, to taste (a few dashes per taco)

Option 1

  • 1 compartment kid tray per child (3-4 compartments, like an EZPZ Happy Mat or similar)
  • Large compartment: stack of 2-3 warm Mission Yellow Corn Tortillas
  • Small compartment: 2.5 oz shredded carnitas
  • Small compartment: 1 Wholly Guacamole Classic Mini (squeezed in)
  • (NO pickled onions, NO hot sauce)

Option 3

  • 1 compartment kid tray per child (3-4 compartments, like an EZPZ Happy Mat or similar)
  • Large compartment: stack of 2-3 warm Mission Yellow Corn Tortillas
  • Small compartment: 2.5 oz shredded carnitas
  • Small compartment: 1 Wholly Guacamole Classic Mini (squeezed in)
  • (NO pickled onions, NO hot sauce)

BRAISE

  • 1/4 cup Kirkland Organic Chicken Sipping Bone Broth

TOPPING SHARED ACROSS ALL PLATES

  • 4 Wholly Guacamole Classic Minis (1 cup per plate, adults AND kids)

ADULT PLATE FORMAT

  • 1 white dinner plate per adult
  • 1 small bowl/ramekin for the carnitas
  • 1 ramekin for the Wholly Guacamole mini (squeezed in)
  • 1 small deli cup for the pickled onions
  • Stack of 3-4 warm Mission Yellow Corn Tortillas

Option 2

  • 1 compartment kid tray per child (3-4 compartments, like an EZPZ Happy Mat or similar)
  • Large compartment: stack of 2-3 warm Mission Yellow Corn Tortillas
  • Small compartment: 2.5 oz shredded carnitas
  • Small compartment: 1 Wholly Guacamole Classic Mini (squeezed in)
  • (NO pickled onions, NO hot sauce)

AT THE PLATE FORMAT. Same carnitas + same tortillas + same Wholly guac for everyone. Adults get a white plate with a small bowl of meat + 3 ramekins of toppings (assemble at the table). Kids get a compartment tray with the same meat + Wholly mini + tortilla stack in separate compartments (assemble at the table). The split lever is the TRAY vs PLATE + the toppings filter (onions + hot sauce on adults only).

Method

Shared base

  1. 1.MISE. Open Del Real tray, Wholly Guacamole minis on counter (1 per plate), Mission tortilla bag open, bone broth pouch ready, Mezzetta jar + Lucky Dog bottle out for adults.
  2. 2.SEAR PHASE. Stainless skillet over medium-high. Drop the Del Real carnitas straight from the tray into the dry hot pan (frozen blocks, not thawed). 2 min undisturbed for contact-sear on the bottom.
  3. 3.DRAIN FAT. Tip the pan, spoon out 2-3 tbsp of rendered fat into a heat-safe bowl. Discard (or save for cooking rice later). This is the calorie lever — skip it and the dish gains 80 cal/serving.
  4. 4.SHRED + BRAISE. Tongs shred the meat into medium pieces (not fine). Pour in 1/4 cup Kirkland Sipping Bone Broth. Glass lid on. 2-3 min until the broth mostly evaporates — visible steam stops escaping the lid edge.
  5. 5.DRY THE SURFACE. Lid off, 60 sec on medium. Stir once. Meat should look glossy-moist, not wet-pooled. Off heat.
  6. 6.WARM TORTILLAS. Dry skillet over medium. Stack of corn tortillas, 30 sec/side. Stack them under a clean towel as they come off to hold warm. Don't pre-warm more than 5 min ahead.

Adult — White Plate + Onions + Lucky Dog

  1. 7.ADULT PLATE. White dinner plate. Small bowl in the center — scoop 5 oz of the shredded carnitas. Ramekin alongside with the squeezed-in Wholly Guacamole mini. Deli cup with 1-2 tbsp pickled onions (let the brine show). Stack 3-4 warm tortillas next to the plate. Lucky Dog bottle on the side.
  2. 8.ASSEMBLE AT THE TABLE. One tortilla at a time. Carnitas first, guac smear, pickled onions on top, hot sauce dashes. Eat over the plate (corn tortillas drip). Repeat. 3-4 tacos per plate.

Kid — Compartment Tray (Build-Your-Own, No Heat) · Option 1

  1. 7.KID TRAY. Compartment tray on the table. Large compartment: 2-3 warm tortillas stacked. Small compartment 1: 2.5 oz shredded carnitas. Small compartment 2: squeezed-in Wholly Guacamole mini. Hand the kid the tray + a small spoon for scooping guac.
  2. 8.ASSEMBLY (kid leads). Most kids pick up a tortilla first, then ask 'meat or guac?' Let them choose. Some will spoon guac directly off the tray and eat it like dip with tortilla as the dipper. Either works — the components are the same calories.

Kid — Compartment Tray (Build-Your-Own, No Heat) · Option 2

  1. 7.Skip the tortillas entirely. Use a regular kid bowl. Scoop 2.5 oz carnitas on one side, dollop the Wholly mini on the other. Spoon-eat. Same protein + calories, just no carb wrapper. Pair with sliced cucumber or strawberries for the side.

Kid — Compartment Tray (Build-Your-Own, No Heat) · Option 3

  1. 7.1 tortilla + 1 slice of shredded mozzarella or Cabot Pepper Jack + 2.5 oz carnitas. Fold the tortilla in half. Skillet over medium 90 sec/side until the cheese melts + the tortilla browns. Cut into 4 wedges. Wholly mini becomes the dip on the side.

SPLIT PLATE SERVING

Adult — White Plate + Onions + Lucky Dog: Serve the adult portion as described above.

Kid — Compartment Tray (Build-Your-Own, No Heat): Serve the kid portion as described above.

Keys to success

  • DROP FROZEN, NOT THAWED. The tray meat goes straight from package into a hot stainless skillet (medium-high). Frozen-block contact gives the bottom 90 sec of contact-sear before the center thaws — that's where the crispy-edge texture comes from.
  • DRAIN FAT AFTER 2 MIN. Tip the skillet, spoon out 2-3 tbsp of rendered fat into a heat-safe bowl (discard or save for cooking rice later). Otherwise the dish lands at 700+ cal/serving.

If something fails

Carnitas came out greasy / oily: You skipped the fat drain after the initial sear. Tip the pan, spoon out 2-3 tbsp BEFORE you add the broth. Next time: drain it before the broth phase, not after.

Meat is dry / stringy by plating: Either you skipped the broth braise (need ~60 sec under the lid) or you over-evaporated. Add another 2 tbsp broth + lid for 30 sec. Should look glossy-moist, not wet-pooled.

Tortillas split / cracked on assembly: Either you microwaved them (microwave dries corn tortillas) or you didn't warm them at all. 30 sec/side in a dry skillet, hold under a towel. Don't pre-warm more than 5 min ahead — they cool + stiffen.

Kid ate the guac mini + ignored the carnitas: Expected on first try with new compartment format. Kid lobbies for guac because the cup is identifiable + portion-bounded. Hold the line — the rule is 'all three components or no second helping'. By night 2-3 they'll start mixing.

Adult plate looks anemic without the heat lift: Either you skipped the pickled onions (the visual brightness anchor) or you used a stingy guac portion. Plate the onions in a small deli cup with the brine visible — color + restaurant signal in one move. Hot sauce bottle on the side as the third color note.

Macros came in higher than 565 cal/adult: Most likely cause: no fat drain (adds ~80 cal) or 4+ tortillas (each one is +50 cal). The 565 budget assumes 5 oz carnitas + 3.5 tortillas average + 1 guac mini. Hot sauce + pickled onions are macro-free.

Storage and reheating

Store: Best fresh — assembly format doesn't reheat well. If you have leftover braised carnitas (rare with this batch math), store in an airtight container with the residual broth. Tortillas store sealed in the original bag at room temp 3-4 days.

Reheat: Carnitas: microwave 60 sec covered + 1 tbsp bone broth splash, stir, 30 sec more. Or skillet over medium 2-3 min. Tortillas: skillet 30 sec/side (microwave cracks them). Don't pre-assemble + store — the tortillas go soggy on contact with the meat.

Lasts: Cooked carnitas leftover holds 3 days in the fridge, freezes 2 months. Tortillas: sealed bag at room temp 3-4 days. Wholly minis: per the package date (usually 5-7 days from opening). Pickled onions: per Mezzetta jar (months). The dish is built for fresh assembly — don't meal-prep this one.

Brands I use

Del Real Foods
Slow-Cooked Carnitas (15 oz / 425g tray — 20g protein per 4 oz serving, fully cooked heat-and-serve)
The 8-minute fast-protein anchor. Slow-roasted pork shoulder in a microwaveable tray, but the stainless skillet sear + bone broth braise is what makes it read as real carnitas (crispy edges + tender pull-apart). One tray = 4 servings = 2 adults + 2 kids at 5oz/2.5oz. Cross-recipe candidate with carnitas bowls.
Mission
Yellow Corn Tortillas Super Soft (Good Fiber, 50 cal / 2g protein / 14g net carbs / 2.5g fiber per tortilla)
Gluten-free + good fiber + the pliable-not-cracky texture that holds 5 oz of carnitas without splitting. Yellow corn is the family default. Warm in a dry skillet 30 sec/side. Don't microwave (cracks on assembly).
Wholly Guacamole
Classic Minis (6-cup pack, 2 oz / cup — 100 cal / 1g protein / 8g fat / 4g fiber per mini)
Pre-portioned guac = portion-creep killer. Mini-cup format gives a hard cap on the highest-fat topping on the plate. Cross-recipe candidate with any Mexican/taco recipe.
Mezzetta
Pickled Red Onions (16 oz jar — ~10 cal per 2 tbsp)
Pre-pickled, ready-to-eat. The brightness foil to the rich carnitas. Adult plate only — kids reject visible red flecks + jar smells. Cross-recipe candidate with adult sandwich recipes (chipotle ham, chicken sandwich).
Lucky Dog
Hot Sauce (5 oz bottle — habanero + jalapeño + garlic, medium-hot)
The adult-only heat layer. Any Lucky Dog variant works (flagship, Year of the Dog, Heat's a Peach). Small-batch, real-pepper, no thickener. Cross-recipe candidate with any adult-side hot sauce slot.
Kirkland Signature
Organic Chicken Sipping Bone Broth (32 fl oz carton or 8.45 fl oz pouches — 9g protein per 8 oz serving)
1/4 cup for the braise — re-hydrates the shredded carnitas + carries rendered flavor back into the meat under the lid. Cross-recipe across id 4, 24, 30, 38, 39, 41.
